cards.title: Introduction to APIs
cards.content:
An Application Programming Interface (API) allows your Vue.js frontend to communicate with a backend server.

We typically use HTTP methods like GET, POST, PUT, and DELETE to interact with RESTful endpoints.

options.text: GET is used to send new data to the server.
POST is typically used to create a new resource on the server.
DELETE is used to update an existing resource.

cards.title: Fetching Data in Vue
cards.content:
In Vue.js, you can fetch data using the native browser fetch API or libraries like Axios.

import axios from 'axios';

async function fetchData() {
  const response = await axios.get('https://api.example.com/data');
  console.log(response.data);
}
